clues.text: The LORD asked Ezekiel whether its wood could be used for anything, even a peg to hang utensils on.
The chief cupbearer told Joseph about his dream, in which one stood right before him.
The LORD God appointed one to grow up and shade Jonah's head, and Jonah was greatly pleased.
Micah foresaw a day when each man sits under his own one and his own fig tree, unafraid.
At the Last Supper, Jesus said He would not drink of its fruit again until His Father's kingdom.
The angel of the LORD told Manoah that his wife must not eat anything that comes from it.
A psalmist said God brought one out of Egypt, drove out the nations, and planted it in their land.
